model_output.cross_horizon_summary: A low-conviction 12h downside-retest lean gives way to a mixed 72h outlook and no defensible net directional edge over 168h. Positive Top-100 participation and ETH-relative improvement are genuine counterweights to the latest BTC/ETH selling, but do not establish durable recovery or canonical altcoin rotation. Forecasts are prospective from issuance, although the latest completed hourly observation ends at 09:00 UTC, approximately 6h47m before issuance. These are descriptive shadow forecasts with no execution authority; they do not authorize portfolio actions or modify framework thresholds or weights.
global_missing_evidence: No market observations bridge the latest completed hourly candle ending at 09:00 UTC to issuance at 15:47:33 UTC. Reported freshness ages reflect the earlier source-packet evaluation, not an issuance-time refresh.
A multi-candle price, spot-flow and derivatives sequence is not supplied, limiting distinction between an isolated retracement and persistent selling.

Breadth and capitalization transmission are proxy-only observations from the same upstream family, not independent confirmations. Canonical large-cap and broad-alt breadth remain unconfirmed; microcaps and the full small-cap universe are unavailable.
Newer settled ETF sessions, a BTC-dominance trajectory and confirmation of stablecoin deployment are absent. Unchanged packet values for reused slow sources are not new observations.

Catalyst context is degraded and no substantive catalyst evidence is supplied. Live-anchor source-observation freshness is unavailable; macro observations are dated slow context rather than contemporaneous directional impulses.

contradicting_evidence: The freshest breadth proxy shows 74% advancing, a positive 1.40% median 24h return and 60 of 100 constituents outperforming BTC.
Large-, mid- and small-alt proxies have positive median returns, with advance ratios of 100%, 75% and approximately 74%, respectively. This is broader strength than BTC resilience alone.
ETH/BTC rose approximately 0.13% in the latest completed hour, despite both assets falling against USDT.
Earlier bid-heavy order books and positive taker imbalances support a possible stabilization attempt, although later hourly selling limits their predictive value.
12h.expected_path: A tentative BTC/ETH-led downside retest is favored over immediate continuation of the preceding 24h gains. Altcoin-relative resilience may coexist with core-market weakness, so this is not a forecast of uniform declines. Selling could settle into stabilization rather than sustained contraction; the observation gap materially weakens the lean.
falsification_conditions: Newer completed observations show sustained BTC and ETH recovery with stronger spot buying while broad proxy participation persists.
The latest selling proves isolated, with subsequent candles holding or recovering rather than extending the decline; this would remove the downside edge even without confirming an uptrend.
missing_evidence: Post-09:00 UTC candles and spot-flow observations.
Repeated order-book observations demonstrating whether earlier bid support persists.
A longer intraday price/open-interest sequence and comparative volume context.
supporting_evidence: BTC fell approximately 0.58% in the latest completed hour and closed at its hourly low; ETH fell approximately 0.47% and closed near its low.
ETH taker-buy quote share was approximately 31.7%, indicating sell-heavy activity in that candle; BTC buying was approximately balanced at 49.6%.
Both assets show PRICE_DOWN_OI_DOWN, recording a deleveraging decline rather than confirming aggressive new short positioning.
Since the prior packet, BTC and ETH prices are lower and proxy breadth has slipped from 76% to 74%; these are modest signs of fading momentum, not proof of broad contraction.

contradicting_evidence: Current breadth and positive medians across observed capitalization buckets provide a plausible foundation for an upward weekly outcome if participation persists.
ETH/BTC's latest improvement and mildly positive BTC ETF flow could develop into stronger recovery evidence, but currently lack persistence.
The preceding weekly price decline and negative multi-session ETF flows provide a plausible downward alternative if the partial recovery fails.
168h.expected_path: No defensible net weekly direction is established. Selective recovery and renewed weakness remain credible alternatives, with neither a sustained expansion nor contraction confirmed. NO_EDGE represents insufficient directional resolution, not a prediction of a flat market or a scheduled regime transition.
falsification_conditions: Repeated price recovery accompanied by persistent ETH/BTC strength, broad participation and improving settled flows would establish an upward edge and supersede NO_EDGE.
Persistent BTC/ETH deterioration accompanied by weakening relative strength, contracting breadth and continued negative settled flows would establish a downward edge and supersede NO_EDGE.
missing_evidence: A sustained post-drawdown price and relative-strength sequence covering multiple sessions.
Persistent canonical breadth confirmation beyond the Top-100 proxy, including unavailable smaller-cap coverage.
Updated settled-flow sequences, BTC-dominance direction and demonstrated deployment of stablecoin liquidity.
supporting_evidence: The supplied evidence combines a preceding weekly drawdown with stronger current 24h proxy participation and renewed hourly selling; it does not resolve the net weekly path.
Latest ETH/BTC improvement is too brief to establish reversal of its completed-week decline.
Stablecoin supply rose approximately 0.81% over 30 days but fell approximately 0.30% over seven days, with deployment explicitly not established.

Altseason scores of 57 on BlockchainCenter's 30d and 90d windows and 66 on CoinMarketCap's 90d measure do not establish broad rotation; the BlockchainCenter source states remain between published thresholds.
The single settled BTC-dominance value and dated macro levels provide context, not a directional trajectory.

contradicting_evidence: Positive breadth is substantial: all observed large-alt constituents advanced, while most mid- and small-alt proxy constituents also advanced.
ETH gained approximately 2.01% over 24h versus BTC's approximately 0.61%, and ETH/BTC improved in the latest hour.
Funding is modest rather than clearly euphoric, and falling open interest during the latest decline can reduce leverage pressure without proving recovery.

72h.expected_path: Recovery attempts and downside retests are both credible, with selective altcoin strength possible while BTC and ETH remain unsettled. Positive participation supports another rebound attempt, but durable continuation requires price, relative strength and flows to improve together. No sequence or transition time is established.
falsification_conditions: Persistent BTC/ETH gains alongside stronger ETH/BTC, resilient breadth and improving settled flows would displace the mixed outlook toward UP.
Repeated failed recoveries alongside sustained selling, deteriorating ETH/BTC and weakening capitalization-proxy participation would displace the mixed outlook toward DOWN.
missing_evidence: Persistence of the current positive breadth and capitalization-bucket medians across subsequent observations.
New settled ETF sessions, especially evidence that ETH outflows are easing.
Spot-demand and derivatives sequences establishing whether deleveraging is followed by renewed demand.
supporting_evidence: The latest hourly BTC/ETH decline conflicts with positive 24h participation, supporting an unsettled rather than cleanly trending outlook.
Completed-week context records sharp BTC and ETH declines followed by only a partial recovery; this supports retest risk without establishing continued contraction.
Five settled ETF sessions in the structural context were negative for both BTC and ETH; the latest ETH session remained negative at 56.1 million reported USD.
Current ETH/BTC improvement counters, but does not yet reverse, its completed-week decline from 0.03152 to 0.03029.

Capitalization proxies demonstrate participation beyond BTC, but fewer than half of the mid- and small-alt proxy constituents outperformed ETH over 24h, limiting evidence of a further broadening leadership handoff.
